script.base: CHI is a 4.5-point home favorite with implied totals CHI 24.0 and NO 19.5, so the book expects a one-score CHI lead in a moderate 43.5 outdoor game, not a shootout and not a slog. If D'Andre Swift (Questionable, groin; 41 carries and 179 rush yards in weeks 3/4/6) is active, CHI runs late once ahead. NO, at +4.5, throws more if trailing: Chris Olave (27 targets, 177 yards, 240 air yards in weeks 4-6) is the volume WR, Rashid Shaheed the boom/bust vertical (16 targets, 189 yards). The run is a near-even split, Alvin Kamara 33/128 and Kendre Miller 29/127, so NO does not have to abandon the run in a one-score game.
script.flip1: CHI gets up early, kills the clock, and NO's rush dies. Miller and Kamara carries stall the way a trailing back's line dies, while Spencer Rattler attempts rise and Olave/Shaheed can see volume without efficiency. Swift, if healthy, is the late-carry winner and CHI WR yardage can stall.
script.flip2: NO hangs around or leads because CHI is allowing 5.72 yards per carry and 22 runs of 10+. Both passing games stay live, Olave's recent 59-then-98 path continues, and the CHI clock-kill never arrives so Swift's late carries do not show up.

pre_mortem: Monday, Miller under 25.5 cashed because NO trailed by two scores, Kamara stayed in as the pass-protection and checkdown back, and Miller repeated the 21-yard week while CHI's 5.72 YPC did not travel against this committee and Jarrett played. Olave under 55.5 cashed because 240 air yards had already produced only 177 receiving yards in the prior three games, CHI took away the outside after the 98, and the uncharted outdoor wind turned the dog-pass script into empty attempts. Those counters are real, which is why both legs stay leans rather than strong, but they are the flip cases, not the base one-score read. Candidates that failed this test and are not legs: Shaheed (114-yard spike, latest 28), Johnson under (Sewell out helps tight ends), Moore under (latest 42 vs 42.5 and a soft NO middle), Swift anything (groin Questionable plus a 108-yard latest rush), Kamara rush (latest 27 and 31, line 43.5, but the run defense is too soft to fade), Monangai (only if Swift is inactive).
